description: Printdash's artwork setup guides as Markdown (bleed and safe zone, print-ready PDFs, colour, double-sided, cut lines, spot finishes, lamination, stocks, white ink, booklets, folding, wide format, Illustrator and InDesign export). Without a topic, the list. With a product (and its configuration), what that product's page says on the topic, sized for the job. The bleed, cut-line and booklet topics include Printdash's own diagram as an image: show that one, not a diagram from elsewhere. Answer file-setup questions from these tools, never from general knowledge: Printdash's bleed differs from the 3 mm many printers use.

configuration.description: The job, to size the product's lead (page size with bleed, pages, plate names).

attributeSelections.description: Simple products: attribute name to the chosen value's label.

coverStockId.description: Booklets: cover stock id, or self for a self cover.

designs.description: Several different designs with the same specs on one item, where get_product offers designs.

finishingIds.description: Finishing option ids, from every finishing field the customer chose.

height.description: Custom finished height in mm (with width).

pages.description: Booklets: page count, one of the pages field's presets.

quantity.description: How many. With designs above 1, how many of EACH design.

sizeId.description: A preset size id from get_product's size field. Or give width and height for a custom size.

stockId.description: Stock id from the stock field.

width.description: Custom finished width in mm (with height), within the size field's limits.

product_id.description: A product, for what its page says on the topic.

topic.description: A guide id (bleed, pdf-export, colour, double-sided, dieline, spot-finishes, lamination, stock-finishes, white-ink, booklets, folding, wide-format, export-illustrator, export-indesign). Omit for the list.

name: get_artwork_guide
